docs.text: Projeect_01 Project Overview This project demonstrates my understanding of Markdown language and its syntax. I have learned how to structure documents using headings, lists, code blocks, links, images, and other Markdown features. Key Concepts Learned Headings: Organize content using # , ## , ### , etc. Lists: Create ordered and unordered lists. Code Blocks: Display code snippets using backticks or triple backticks. Links: Add hyperlinks to external resources. Images: Embed images using Markdown syntax. Emphasis: Use italic and bold text for emphasis. Example Markdown Syntax # Heading 1 ## Heading 2 - Unordered list item 1. Ordered list item **Bold text** *Italic text* [Link to Markdown Guide](https://www.markdownguide.org) Outcome By completing this project, I am now able to write clear and well-structured documentation using Markdown.
